sources.title: Getting started - Open API
exact_facts_supported: Maximum 50 non-historical requests per second per connection.
Maximum 5 historical requests per second per connection.

sources.title: OpenApiMessages.proto
exact_facts_supported: ProtoOASymbolsListReq supports includeArchivedSymbols.
ProtoOASymbolsListRes returns current light symbols and archived-symbol records.
ProtoOASymbolByIdReq/Res returns full symbol entities and can return archived-symbol records.
ProtoOASymbolsForConversionReq/Res returns broker conversion-chain symbols.
ProtoOAExpectedMarginReq is a margin-estimation request and does not place an order.
ProtoOAGetTrendbarsReq and ProtoOAGetTickDataReq provide historical market-data requests.

sources.title: OpenApiModelMessages.proto
exact_facts_supported: Current model schema defines light, full and archived symbol structures used by structural mapping.
Trendbar timestamps identify bar-open time; bar completion must be enforced by the capture client.
Historical tick quote type distinguishes BID and ASK.

sources.title: Open API FAQ
exact_facts_supported: Send a heartbeat at least once every 10 seconds to avoid inactivity disconnects.
HTTP/protocol rate-limit errors require respecting the current request-rate limitations.
